messages:
elena: FYI — automated health checks flagged intermittent ECC parity and Xid errors on 3 dedicated GPU cards in eu1-dc3 this morning. One host already failed a soft-drain and workloads moved to warm pool.需要 customer comm?
ops-bot: [alert] 1832109602: detected ECC_PARITY_MULTI on gpu-card 0 in host eu1-dc3-rack12-node7. Auto-drain initiated. trace: /var/log/nvme/gpu/err-1832109602.log
sam: thanks elena. can you confirm affected customers (dedicated/private) and whether any live failovers caused client-visible errors?
elena: affected: 2 dedicated tenants on reserved pools (acct: acme-ai, acct: fin-ml). Failovers completed; no API 5xx observed but a small uptick in tail latency (p95) while warm pool ramped. I've opened ticket INF-1289 and scheduled hardware replace for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
maya: draft comm should be proactive, short, and include what we did, impact, timeline, and mitigation steps. Recommend we phrase as a maintenance/replace + reassurance about failover. Avoid over-technical ECC/Xid deep dives.
sam: agree. here's a short draft for customer email/notice — please review: ```Hi — We detected degraded GPU hardware in our eu1 region affecting a small number of Dedicated/Private instances. Traffic was automatically routed to standby capacity and your workloads continued running. We will be replacing the affected cards during a maintenance window on <date/time UTC>. You should not need to take any action. If you'd like us to schedule a coordinated maintenance, reply to this message or open a support ticket. Apologies for the inconvenience — Redwood Inference Team```
maya: tweak: add expected duration and rollback notes: mention max ~30m intermittent latency during swap. also link to support ticket INF-1289.
sam: updated draft with timeline: ```We will replace the affected hardware starting 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC with an expected disruption window of up to 30 minutes for redistribution of capacity. During replacement we will route traffic to warm capacity and run validation checks; in the unlikely event of migration failures we will roll back to the prior host which may cause a repeat short failover.```
alex: add statement about guarantees: "No data was lost. We are operating under our Dedicated capacity SLA; if you experienced visible errors, please reply or open INF-1289." Also add contact link for scheduled coordination.
elena: Can someone confirm we have spare capacity for both accounts during the window? ops?
ops-bot: [capacity-check] available-warm-units eu1: 12 GPUs free; reserved-pool buffer: 2 GPUs. projected utilization during 02:00-03:00 UTC: 78%.
maya: buffer is low but sufficient for 2 tenanted replacements. include a note: "If you'd like a dedicated coordinated swap, we can arrange a private maintenance window."
customer-success: LGTM. small language tweaks: remove phrase "we will replace the affected hardware" -> "we will replace the affected GPU cards" and remove the word "inconvenience". Keep it crisp.
sam: final proposed customer-facing message (single paragraph): ```Hi — We detected degraded GPU cards in eu1 that affected a small number of Dedicated/Private instances. Traffic was automatically routed to standby capacity and workloads continued running. We will replace the affected GPU cards during a maintenance window on 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. The expected disruption window for redistribution is up to 30 minutes; our team will validate performance post-replacement. No data was lost. If you experienced errors or want a coordinated maintenance time, please reply or open ticket INF-1289.```
elena: thanks — I'll send to both accounts after we get final approval from acct-security for the maintenance. Can we also add a short post-send follow-up note to the customers after replacement summarizing validation metrics (p50/p95 latency, token throughput)?
alex: yes, add that as a 24h follow-up. include links to per-route latency graphs in Console and note which hosts were swapped (sanitized host ids).
maya: thumbs up emoji :thumbsup: — final approval from customer-success?
customer-success: Approved. I'll queue the message to both customers and CC infra. Sending tomorrow morning 08:00 UTC local copy and support ticket updated.```
